flora: Zizyphus-like scrub (multi-stemmed, sprawling, covered in tiny waxy leaves and small white flowers)
Small Araucariaceae trees in the background
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; focus on the dense, barrier-like habit of the scrub; a warm, hazy color temperature.

visual_logic.composition: A view of the floodplain showing a dense, sprawling thicket of the multi-stemmed Zizyphus-like scrub, forming a low barrier along a river bank. Volcanic grey ash deposits are visible in the red clay.
visual_logic.ground: Dry, silty red clay mud with patches of grey volcanic ash.
visual_logic.lighting: Warm, direct sunlight making the small waxy leaves shine.
